verdict.rationale: ADK is itself an official Google SDK/framework. First-party docs state it is available in Python, TypeScript, Go, Java, and Kotlin, and the official adk-python repo documents code-first development with code samples. Versioned releases come with per-language migration guidance. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and documentation depth for the non-Python SDKs (TypeScript/Go/Java/Kotlin), which is asserted but not detailed here.
